sources.title: Logics-MLLM/Logics-STEM-8B-SFT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🔎 Overview Logics-STEM-8B-SFT is an 8B-parameter open reasoning model for STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) tasks. It is fine-tuned from Qwen3-8B using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on Logics-STEM-SFT-Dataset-2.2M, a large-scale long chain-of-thought dataset covering math and broader STEM problems.
